purpose: Critical follow-up review; implemented fixes, temporary fixtures only. This supersedes the prototype validation for changed storage paths.
source_binding: 84 distinct development cases reran after lexical past-path validation and late-writer fixes. After the final document-membership guard, all 27 storage/retention cases and the two selected v3 lifecycle/migration cases passed; their union is 85 distinct cases. The NUL path case also passed. Hashes identify the final uncommitted source; measurement freezes and checks these runtime bytes independently.
findings_fixed: Historical physical copies could shadow CAS authority; links now validate manifests/objects and protect exact dependency bytes in preview/load/export.
Referenced inventory aggregate budget was checked after reading another object; reject before IO/parse.
Object preparation/publication race could overwrite existing bytes; publish exclusively, verify the winning object, refuse damaged content.
Regular reads could become unbounded after stat; request only limit + 1 and reject excess.
History kept all stable bytes in an extra dictionary; process sources incrementally without reducing verification.
POSIX rename could replace an empty directory created during export; require native exclusive rename, fail closed if unsupported.
Pending journal was exposed during writing/fsync; publish only complete synced bytes, without replacement.
Recheck sources after journal ownership and clear only our exact journal before any mutable write; do not undo competing bytes matching the proposed result.

Validate every inventory/historical source name lexically as past data; real accesses retain link/nested-repository checks. Historical objects stay readable when the original location becomes a nested repository.
Recheck exact document membership after acquiring the pending journal: additions during preparation invalidate authorization while preserving the new document.
compatibility: Legacy snapshot trees and schema 2.0 journals read/recover; migrations keep their own namespaces. v2/v3 inventories inline/ref accepted; project Markdown remains canonical. No consumer installation or compaction.

review_regression.cause: Historical resolution initially reached history/migration-.../tree, which has a different representation.
review_regression.correction: Only v2 snapshot history/<16 hex>/tree uses the manifest resolver.

test_fixture_repairs: New migration assertion initially chained v2 require_valid(), whose return is None; corrected the fixture without changing the loader.

No host acceptance or consumer migration executed
Logical byte counts exclude filesystem allocation and Git object sharing
Three load observations per runtime; one synthetic run on one Windows host. No claim of general performance improvement. Archive preparation plus apply is slower in this final run.

limits: Windows actual filesystem tested, including paths > MAX_PATH. Linux/macOS export failure dispatch tested with doubles; actual hosts not run.
No proof of universal optimality. Complete per-state metadata and transaction collection retain bounded growth costs.
Fault injection verifies process-operation exceptions, not power-loss or network-filesystem durability.
Technical smoke assertions passed individually; complete stable release gate not run because this is an uncommitted, unapproved release version.
